incumbent_comparison: Compared directly with best-so-far citizen-v005 under the same seven RoomScale run-002 captures, v7 retains v5's improved proportions and face clearance while adding a visibly woven torso/cap material and tailored back details without the v6 cross seam. The 12-inch camera shows both candidates at the same scene scale and v7 keeps the same readable humanoid silhouette. The improvements are specific and the technical gate passes.
next_action_hypothesis: Promote citizen-v007 as the accepted semantic citizen visual. Keep the current gameplay, selection, navigation, role equipment, and animator logic unchanged; preserve the earlier failed and superseded challengers for the iteration history.

observations.art_direction_fit: The compact cap, paired brass goggles, winding detail, woven coat, and hardware fit the miniature clockwork-worker direction at both close and gameplay scales.
observations.close_up_quality: The matched run-002 detail and profile views show the raised brim clear of the goggles, textured cloth, a thin cap seam, compact winding, and low-contrast back tailoring. The face remains intentionally stylized at this miniature scale but no longer reads as a blank primitive head.
observations.gameplay_readability: The run-002 12-inch production follow capture frames the selected citizen in the live room among other citizens; its torso, head, arms, and legs remain discernible by silhouette and uniform colors, while close-up-only details are not relied on for gameplay reading.
observations.geometric_detail: The run-002 front and reverse close captures show layered lapels and vest, badge, cap winding, paired goggles, cuffs, boot soles, and tailored reverse seams. The 81 meshes remain presentation-only and keep the established rig pivots.
observations.material_realism: The run-002 close renders show a deterministic woven fabric pattern on the coat and cap, distinct dark leather, brass/iron hardware, warm skin, and reflective dark glass under production lighting. The visible weave improves the formerly smooth torso material.
observations.proportion: Godot measures 0.264 x 0.5016 x 0.1791 inches. The figure fits the half-inch height and passes the ArtBrief's largest-to-smallest axis-ratio tolerance.
observations.scale_fidelity: Technical validation reports bounds 0.264 x 0.5016 x 0.1791 inches and no tolerance issues. The production presentation gate confirms citizens remain within the half-inch envelope.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The run-002 close three-quarter and detail renders clearly identify a miniature citizen/worker through the human silhouette, twin goggles, clockwork cap winding, tailored coat, and boots. The 12-inch follow view retains a readable humanoid figure among the 50 active agents.
observations.silhouette_quality: Against the matched run-002 v5 captures, v7 retains the narrower raised cap and domed shoulders, while the darker compact cap seam and restrained rear darts avoid the v6 cross-shaped harness read.
observations.surface_variation: The citizen-only tileable warp-and-weft texture is visibly resolved on both the torso and cap at the 2-inch production close view; its fine pattern naturally collapses at the 12-inch gameplay camera.
observations.technical_integration: Godot import/bounds validation passes with 81 meshes, 21,888 triangles, and no issues. The run-002 receipt identifies citizen-v007 and its exact scene path with production_path=true. The presentation gate confirms all 50 agents use it with animated pivots and independent role components.
